sources.title: Original GLM-5.2 Coding Plan availability announcement
sources.evidence: Original post retrieved via native X syndication: author Zai_org, timestamp June 13, 2026 at 07:56:46 UTC, explicitly says GLM-5.2 is now available to all GLM Coding Plan users, including Lite, Pro, Max and Team. Native text is truncated after the availability sentence; the full-text mirror additionally says API, chatbot and MIT weights will follow the next week. The release date relies on the native availability text and timestamp.

sources.title: Z.ai release notes for the full GLM-5.2 launch
sources.evidence: Explicit June 16, 2026 GLM-5.2 release entry, separate from earlier June 13 Coding Plan availability. Documents 1M context and long-horizon coding improvements.

sources.title: GLM-5.2 exact checkpoint card
sources.evidence: Exact pinned card declares MIT and public deployment, a 1M context, high/max reasoning effort, IndexShare across four sparse-attention layers and improved MTP. It links the earlier GLM-5 report, which does not contain GLM-5.2-specific accounting.

sources.title: Official GLM family download table at pinned revision
sources.evidence: Exact GLM-5.2 row directly reports 744B-A40B and BF16, separately from GLM-5.2-FP8 and other releases. These are author nominal figures; the row does not define embedding/output or MTP boundaries. The same README explicitly identifies the GLM-5.2 IndexShare architecture and its high/max reasoning settings.

sources.title: GLM-5.2 exact checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM with 78 main layers, first 3 dense, 256 routed experts/top 8 plus 1 shared expert, 6144 hidden width, MLA latent ranks, sparse-attention indexer sharing and one MTP module. max_position_embeddings=1048576; input/output embeddings untied; BF16 weights with router dtype float32.

sources.title: GLM-5.2 tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: model_max_length=1048576, agreeing with checkpoint capacity. Generic image/audio special tokens do not establish multimodal model inputs.

sources.title: GLM-5.2 checkpoint MIT license
sources.evidence: Exact repository contains the MIT License, copyright 2026 Zhipu AI, matching the exact model-card declaration.

sources.title: GLM-5.2 exact chat template
sources.evidence: Template handles text content, tool definitions/calls/results, think blocks, enable_thinking, clear_thinking and high/max reasoning effort. Shared multimodal vocabulary is not used as proof of image/audio support.

sources.title: GLM-5.2 native API guide
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown guide explicitly lists text input and text output, 1M context, 128K maximum output, thinking modes and function calling. Examples identify glm-5.2.

sources.title: GLM-5.2 original technical launch article
sources.evidence: Indexed original article dated June 16, 2026 describes IndexShare: every four Transformer layers reuse a lightweight indexer. It discusses MTP index reuse and KV sharing. Direct HTML is an empty client-rendered shell; relevant original article text was accessed through web search.

sources.title: Earlier GLM-5 technical report checked for counting scope
sources.evidence: The report linked by the GLM-5.2 card contains no GLM-5.2 mention. Table 10 defines embedding/output exclusions and MTP inclusion for GLM-4.5 and GLM-5, so that convention is not silently applied to GLM-5.2.

sources.title: Exact GLM-5.2 public checkpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Public ungated repository lists 282 safetensors weight shards. Its automatic BF16/F32 storage aggregates were not reconciled across every tensor header and are not treated as an exact learned parameter count.

name.note: Exact named release, separate from FP8 packaging and later GLM-5.3.

developer.note: Original publisher is Z.ai; its checkpoint license names Zhipu AI.

family.note: Official GLM model family and explicit GLM-5.1 successor.

release_date.note: Earliest confirmed public availability was the Coding Plan release on June 13. The broader API/chatbot/open-weight launch is documented June 16; repository creation is not used as release evidence.

open_weights.note: Official public ungated checkpoint with BF16 shards and local deployment instructions. Open-weight status describes the subsequent named checkpoint, not availability on the initial Coding Plan release day.

license.note: Verified exact checkpoint license file and matching model card; separate GitHub code licensing is not substituted.

parameters_b.note: Author-reported nominal 744B total from the exact GLM-5.2 download row. The row does not specify embeddings/output/MTP boundaries, and the earlier GLM-5 convention is not transferred. Automatic repository storage totals are not a reconciled unique learned count.

active_parameters_b.note: Author-reported nominal A40B. Exact checkpoint routes to 8 of 256 experts plus a shared expert per MoE layer; no precise activation phase or embedding/output/MTP accounting is claimed.

architecture.note: Causal text MoE Transformer with MLA and DSA/IndexShare. Exact config gives 3 dense and 75 MoE main layers, top 8 of 256 routed experts plus 1 shared expert, and one MTP module. IndexShare reuses top-k token selections across groups of four sparse-attention layers.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint and tokenizer capacity; native guide advertises rounded 1M. Corrects baseline 1000000. Maximum output is a separate 128K API limit.

modalities.note: Native text input/output, confirmed by exact config and template. Shared tokenizer image/video/audio tokens and applications that generate interface code do not establish native multimodal input.

reasoning.note: Native thinking mode and exact template support think blocks, thinking on/off and high/max effort settings.

tool_call.note: Native function calling plus exact checkpoint tool definitions, structured calls and tool responses.

description.value: Text MoE model with IndexShare sparse attention, a 1M-token context and configurable reasoning effort.
description.note: Plain summary of verified architecture, context and reasoning controls; removes flagship and broad performance claims.

patch.description: Text MoE model with IndexShare sparse attention, a 1M-token context and configurable reasoning effort.
patch.notes: First available to all GLM Coding Plan tiers on June 13, 2026; the broader launch followed June 16. Z.ai reports nominal 744B total and 40B active for this exact model. Its model-specific download row does not resolve embedding/output/MTP accounting; the earlier GLM-5 counting convention is not assumed. The checkpoint uses MoE with MLA, DSA and IndexShare, plus one MTP module. Configured and tokenizer context capacity is 1048576 tokens, advertised as 1M; API maximum output is separate. MIT applies to the public weights.

summary: Verified all 14 fields. Confirmed June 13 Coding Plan release ahead of June 16 broader launch, MIT open weights, directly reported nominal 744B/40B, and exact MoE/MLA/DSA/IndexShare architecture. Corrected context to 1048576 and replaced unsupported descriptive language. No sibling counting convention or unreconciled storage aggregate is presented as an exact full parameter count.
